name: TAKANAWA GATEWAY Convention Center
address: Tokyo 108-0074 THE LINKPILLAR 1 SOUTH B2F/B1F/6F, 2-21-2 Takanawa, Minato-ku
accessSummary: Directly connected to Takanawa Gateway Station (JR Yamanote Line, Keihin-Tohoku Line and Negishi Line) / Sengakuji Station Exit A2, via an outdoor route
hours: In principle 9:00-21:00 (usage slots: morning 9:00-12:00 / afternoon 13:00-17:00 / evening 18:00-21:00; all day 9:00-21:00). Usage time includes setup and cleanup. Extensions are accepted between 8:00 and 23:00. Open all year except on maintenance and inspection days and closed days.
notice: Applications are reviewed by the facility, and a request may not be accepted. Procedures and guidance are in Japanese, and applications cannot be made verbally or by phone (return the Application for Use form by e-mail). The start of acceptance differs by rental room: 2 years before the start date of use for the entire span of LINKPILLAR Hall; 1 year before for split use of the hall, Room 1 and the entire span of 6F Conference Hall; 6 months before for Rooms 2 to 7, Rooms 601 to 604 and split use of Conference Hall (in each case, the first reception day of that month). Outside food and drink may not be brought in.

ops.loadingHours: The B2F LINKPILLAR Hall has a directly connected loading space, with an opening 3.3 m high x 3 m wide. Load-in and load-out are also done within the usage time (which includes setup and cleanup). Moving heavy items in or out requires advance notice, and floors and walls are protected as instructed by the facility manager. Packages sent in advance require advance notice, and should be scheduled to arrive on the evening of the previous day for morning use (the last business day before, if the previous day is a closed day) or on the morning of the day for afternoon use. Storage is free for up to 3 items, and from the 4th item it is 550 yen per item per day (tax included). For large quantities or large items, a storage space may have to be rented for a fee. (Source: Facility details, Terms of Use March 2025, Furniture and Equipment Price List January 2026)
ops.vehicleRules: There is a loading space, and bringing in goods by vehicle requires advance application. The B2F LINKPILLAR Hall has a dedicated loading bay. The organizer is responsible for sorting, guiding and securing visitors' cars (if many visitors are expected, for example, the facility manager arranges this and the cost is borne by the organizer). (Source: FAQ, Facility details, Terms of Use March 2025)
ops.parking: If you come by car, use the parking lot of TAKANAWA GATEWAY CITY.
ops.waitingRooms: B2F: Anteroom L1 (24㎡), L2 (26㎡), L3 (25㎡) and L4 (20㎡). They can be reserved only when renting LINKPILLAR Hall, and anterooms are not rented on their own. 6F: Anteroom 1 (22㎡) and Anteroom 2 (17㎡), and Meeting Rooms 1 to 5 (37㎡, 17㎡, 17㎡, 23㎡ and 18㎡; for waiting rooms or small meetings). The 6F anterooms and Meeting Rooms are also not rented on their own.
ops.catering: Outside food and drink may not be brought in (to ensure food safety and public hygiene; boxed meals are not allowed either). Catering is offered by the facility as an additional service: party plans from 10 companies (4,950 to 12,500 yen, tax included, with food and 2 hours of all-you-can-drink; each company has a minimum number of people, such as from 30 to 50), and boxed meals from 8 companies (693 to 1,430 yen, tax included; there is a minimum total amount). Serving sweets is allowed. (Source: Catering Service, FAQ, Terms of Use March 2025)
ops.restaurants: Meetings and seminars and receptions use separate venues because of setup arrangements. Food for a reception is arranged through the party plans offered as an additional service. (Source: FAQ, Catering Service)
